about.title: About
about.intro.p1: Kingshot Data is an unofficial fan site run by Ten, who also operates the Naver Kingshot Guide Cafe. Ten, 킹샷 and 텐 are names used by the same operator in that community. The site builds on guides and materials organized in the cafe, making building information, hero information and development calculators easier to find and compare.
about.intro.p2: Alongside the operator's guides, members' gameplay experiences help identify areas to improve. We consider their server generation, development level, available materials and unsuccessful attempts as well as successful results. We turn these experiences into topic-specific decision criteria and practical steps, crediting the Naver Kingshot Guide Cafe, the author and the original posting date for materials used.
about.intro.p3: Personal observations and estimates are distinguished from confirmed game rules. One account's score or an older season's figures do not establish the same result for every player. Reproducing original wording, images or charts requires a separate check of the source and usage rights.
about.ads.p1: The site may include advertising or affiliate links to support its operation.
about.ads.p2: The site may receive a commission from use or purchases through some affiliate links. Review the product or service terms and decide based on your own needs and budget.
about.copyright.p1: Game images, trademarks and other protected materials belong to their respective rights holders. Kingshot Data is an unofficial fan site operated independently of the game developer and publisher. We distinguish sources and contributions when drawing on operator and member materials, and check usage rights separately before reproducing original text, images or charts.
about.disclaimer.p1:
Displayed values may differ from the actual game due to updates.
This site assumes no legal responsibility for outcomes resulting from the use of its information.

about.intro.p4: If a guide differs from your current game screen, send the page, your server's progression and a relevant screen or reproducible conditions through the contact page. For calculators, the inputs and expected result help us locate the difference. Questions and feedback from the community continue to inform improvements to hero equipment, pets, buildings and development calculators.
